findings.passage: Each mass shooting is different, but a common denominator in each incident is that the shooter used a large-capacity magazine. As experience has shown, large-capacity magazine limitation laws decrease the deadly impacts of mass shootings by reducing the number of people who will be shot during a mass shooting incident — and save lives. It is critical that courts uphold these common-sense gun safety laws,
findings.note: Statement quoted by Colorado Newsline (republished by Kiowa County Press) when he joined 18 other attorneys general in a court brief backing Washington, D.C.'s limit on magazines over 10 rounds.

findings.motion: Joined 18 other attorneys general in court brief supporting D.C. large-capacity magazine law
findings.note: As attorney general he signed on to a multi-state court brief defending D.C.'s ban on magazines holding more than 10 rounds against a Second Amendment challenge.

findings.passage: We know from our work leading the Domestic Violence Fatality Review Board that most domestic violence-related murders involve firearms,” Weiser said in a statement. “Consequently, when it comes to protecting domestic violence victims from being harmed or killed by their abusers, it’s clear that gun safety protections make a difference and saves lives.
findings.note: Statement quoted by The Gazette on the federal law barring gun possession by people under domestic violence restraining orders, after he joined 25 attorneys general asking the U.S. Supreme Court to uphold it.
